description: The main window. App commands (notesd_connect, notesd_send, open_url, open_file, spike_mode, spike_report, spike_say) are allowed by default. Of Tauri's own, only what the page uses: event listening (the window's events), the window controls of the app's own title bar and the close that waits for unsaved notes (destroy), and the webview's zoom, never core:default's menus, tray, images or paths.
